docsIntro: Everything you need to know to run your shop, track your cash flow, and manage your team using DukaanOS.
docsS1Desc: Create your business account, select your currency and timezone, and configure your primary store branch.
docsS1Step1: Register at /register with your name, store name, and password.
docsS1Step2: Complete the 1-minute onboarding wizard to set your default branch and currency.
docsS1Step3: Access your central /dashboard to view sales, profit, and alerts in real time.
docsS2Desc: Add items, print barcodes, set minimum stock alerts, and track physical counts accurately.
docsS2Step1: Navigate to Products to add items with SKU, barcode, wholesale purchase cost, and retail selling price.
docsS2Step2: Set a Low Stock Threshold so DukaanOS alerts you before you run out of essential goods.
docsS2Step3: Stock updates automatically with every POS sale and supplier purchase shipment.
docsS3Desc: High-speed counter billing designed for barcode scanners and keyboard shortcuts.
docsS3Step1: Scan barcodes directly into the POS search bar to instantly add items to the cart.
docsS3Step2: Choose customer type (Walk-in or registered credit customer) and apply discounts.
docsS3Step3: Tender sales via Cash, Split Payment, or Credit (Udhaar).
docsS3Step4: Instantly print 58mm, 80mm thermal receipts or standard A4 invoices.
docsS4Desc: Keep complete customer ledgers and recover outstanding credit balances easily.
docsS4Step1: Credit sales automatically update the customer's outstanding debt in the ledger.
docsS4Step2: Go to Customers to see who owes money and view complete transaction history.
docsS4Step3: Click "Record Payment" when a customer pays cash to reconcile their balance immediately.
docsS5Desc: Understand gross sales, cost of goods sold (COGS), daily expenses, and true net profit.
docsS5Step1: View Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly financial summaries in the Reports portal.
docsS5Step2: Track realized profit margins per item and identify your most profitable categories.
docsS5Step3: Filter reports by branch to evaluate multi-outlet retail performance.
docsS6Desc: Automated operational guidance highlighting risks and growth opportunities.
docsS6Step1: DukaanOS continuously reviews your stock, sales velocity, and credit exposure.
docsS6Step2: Receive proactive alerts on low-stock items, slow-moving dead inventory, and margin drops.
docsS6Step3: View evidence-backed recommendations to improve store cash flow.
docsS7Desc: Role-based access control and biometric attendance tracking for store employees.
docsS7Step1: Create staff profiles and assign roles: Manager, Cashier, or Stock Helper.
docsS7Step2: Log daily attendance (Present, Absent, Late) and track leaves.
docsS7Step3: Disburse monthly salaries and record transparent payroll ledger entries.
docsS8Desc: Continue selling even when your internet connection drops during peak store hours.
docsS8Step1: When network disconnects, DukaanOS switches seamlessly into Offline Mode.
docsS8Step2: Sales are queued securely on your local device without storing sensitive credentials.
docsS8Step3: Upon reconnecting, transactions sync idempotently to the server without duplicate billing.

privacyIntro: At DukaanOS, we believe your business data belongs entirely to you. This Privacy Policy transparently explains what data we process, why we need it, and how your privacy is protected.
privacyS1Body: Every business registered on DukaanOS operates in a strictly isolated tenant environment. Your sales numbers, inventory levels, customer names, employee records, and profit margins are completely inaccessible to other store owners. We never monetize, sell, or aggregate your proprietary transaction data for third-party advertising.
privacyS2Item1Text: Name, business name, phone number, and securely hashed passwords (Bcrypt salt rounds 10).
privacyS2Item2Text: Product catalog details, supplier purchase records, POS transaction invoices, and customer credit ledger balances.
privacyS2Item3Text: Employee rosters, daily attendance logs, and salary payment records entered by authorized store managers.
privacyS2Item4Text: IP addresses and system error digests recorded exclusively for security rate limiting and crash debugging.
privacyS3Body: All client-server communications use modern TLS/HTTPS encryption. Sensitive credentials such as passwords, external API tokens, and local CCTV camera URLs are automatically redacted from server logs. DukaanOS enforces strict role-based access control (Owner, Manager, Cashier, Employee) ensuring staff can only access features permitted by their assigned role.
privacyS4Body: You retain 100% data portability. Business owners can export complete store records (Products, Customers, Invoices, Udhaar Ledgers, Purchases) in standardized JSON and CSV formats at any time via the Settings → Data Export portal.
privacyFooter: DukaanOS — Built for Small Retail Businesses
supportMainTitle: How can we help you today?
supportIntro: Find quick answers to common questions about running your store with DukaanOS, or explore our full documentation handbook.
supportFaq1Q: How do I start using DukaanOS for my shop?
supportFaq1A: Simply click "Start Free" on the homepage, enter your email and password, and create your business profile. You can start adding products and making sales immediately in under 2 minutes.
supportFaq2Q: Does DukaanOS work when my internet goes down?
supportFaq2A: Yes! DukaanOS has built-in offline POS support. If your connection drops during a rush, you can continue scanning barcodes and making sales. Once your connection returns, all queued transactions synchronize safely to the server.
supportFaq3Q: How does Customer Udhaar (Credit) tracking work?
supportFaq3A: When completing a sale on the POS terminal, select a registered customer and choose "Credit" or enter a partial payment amount. The unpaid balance is automatically added to the customer's ledger. You can record payments later to reconcile the balance.
supportFaq4Q: Can I use barcode scanners and thermal receipt printers?
supportFaq4A: Yes! DukaanOS POS supports standard USB/Bluetooth barcode guns (which input directly into the search bar) and provides standard 58mm, 80mm, and A4 printable receipt layouts.
supportFaq5Q: Can multiple cashiers use the system at the same time?
supportFaq5A: Yes. DukaanOS features atomic database row locks that prevent cashiers from overselling stock during simultaneous checkouts.
supportFaq6Q: Is my store data private and secure?
supportFaq6A: Absolutely. DukaanOS enforces strict multi-tenant database isolation. Your store inventory, sales, customer ledgers, and profit reports are only accessible to you and your authorized staff.
termsIntro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using the DukaanOS platform. By creating an account or accessing our software, you agree to abide by these terms.
termsS1Body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your business account. Store owners must ensure that staff members are assigned appropriate authorization roles (e.g. Cashier, Manager) and that compromised accounts are promptly deactivated.
termsS2Body: DukaanOS is designed to facilitate lawful retail commerce, point-of-sale operations, inventory management, and customer relations. You agree not to use the platform for unlawful financial schemes, malicious security probing, or attempting to circumvent multi-tenant access controls.
termsS3Body: While DukaanOS provides offline-aware POS capabilities that allow sales to be queued locally on your browser during temporary network outages, the central server remains the authoritative source of truth upon reconnection. DukaanOS is provided on an "as is" basis without warranties of uninterrupted uptime during third-party internet or hosting outages.
